svg.title: Latent diffusion on FLIP, trained as two jobs
svg.desc: Job 1, the autoencoder tutorial, trains an encoder and decoder that compress a 96 by 112 by 80 brain MRI volume (2 mm voxels) into a 3 by 24 by 28 by 20 latent and back, with reconstruction, KL, MedicalNet perceptual and patch-discriminator losses; every weight is averaged across Trusts. Its result, FL_global_model.pt, is turned by make prepare-checkpoint into pretrained_autoencoder.pt and autoencoder_config.yaml; the published autoencoder on Hugging Face is the alternative. Job 2, the latent_diffusion_model tutorial, uploads that pair: the frozen encoder turns each volume into a latent, noise is added, and a diffusion UNet conditioned on the MR sequence learns to predict the noise. Only the UNet is trained and averaged. To generate, the UNet denoises random latent noise over 1000 steps and the frozen decoder turns the latent into a synthetic MRI volume of the chosen sequence. Brain MRI images illustrate each stage.
